description: The plot illustrates the similarity of HSAs in different languages across all layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 0 to 22 at regular intervals of 2, with no units specified. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05, also without units. The plot contains four solid lines without markers, representing different language pairs: en&en (red), en&es (blue), en&el (green), and en&bn (pink). All four lines follow a similar trajectory across the x-axis. The red solid line for "en&en" begins at approximately 0.08 at layer 0, rises to a sharp peak of roughly 0.26 at layer 5, declines to about 0.12 at layer 7, and then rises to a broader peak near 0.18 between layers 11 and 13. It then steadily declines to a low of approximately 0.08 at layer 20 before exhibiting a sharp spike to end at roughly 0.42 just past layer 22. The blue solid line for "en&es" starts at approximately 0.06 at layer 0, peaks at roughly 0.24 at layer 5, drops to about 0.10 at layer 7, and rises to a secondary peak near 0.15 between layers 11 and 13; it then declines to roughly 0.06 at layer 20 and ends with a sharp spike to approximately 0.28. The green solid line for "en&el" begins at roughly 0.05 at layer 0, reaches a peak of about 0.23 at layer 5, falls to approximately 0.08 at layer 7, and rises to near 0.14 between layers 11 and 13, before dropping to about 0.05 at layer 20 and spiking to end at roughly 0.26. Finally, the pink solid line for "en&bn" starts at approximately 0.04 at layer 0, peaks at roughly 0.22 at layer 5, declines to about 0.07 at layer 7, and rises to near 0.13 between layers 11 and 13; it decreases to roughly 0.05 at layer 20 and concludes with a sharp spike to approximately 0.25 just past layer 22.
